title: Plural genitive before a noun
summary: Use a plural genitive for several owners or related things: lasten kirja (“the children's book”).
objectives: Use a plural genitive for several owners or related things: lasten kirja (“the children's book”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: The modifier is plural when it refers to several people or things. The thing owned can still be singular: several children can share one book.
The local models are lapsi → lasten/lapsien, nainen → naisten/naisien, talo → talojen and koulu → koulujen. Both alternatives shown for the person words are standard.
The head nouns ovet (“doors”) and ikkunat (“windows”) are supplied plural forms of ovi and ikkuna. Choose the modifier's number independently.
keyPoints: Plural owners do not require a plural thing owned.

steps: Use lasten for more than one lapsi. The number of the following noun is independent.
